forward_patch:
--- original
+++ modified
@@ -0,0 +1,16 @@
+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '80'
+title: 'MT-9 (part): mount an operation tool of the host under a noun'
+---
+TestudoApp Step 1 needs this. FoundationModelsACPAgent card ^e7qftfw waits for it (ACPA-17, the `settings` tool). Design: TestudoApp/features/packages/foundationmodels-multitool.md, MT-9, "Tools of the host"; decision D100 (f).
+
+- Add `MultiTool.Builder.withOperationTool(noun:tool:)`. It takes `any OperationDescribing` and a noun that the host gives. Multitool does not know the type of the tool.
+- The method records an internal capability, so the noun is owned: a second registration under the noun fails at `buildRegistry()`.
+- Each operation becomes one verb `tools.<noun>.<verb>`, through the same registry and `runCode` path as the tools of Multitool. Thus the risk check (MT-1) sees each call when it comes.
+- Update the header of `Capabilities/Files/Read.swift`, which says that the package has no operation machinery.
+- Not in this card: `withSessions(_:)` and the `Operations` product of Extras (Step 6). `withSessions` can call `withOperationTool(noun: "sessions", tool:)`.
+
+Tests: the mount paths under the host noun, the noun is owned, and a `runCode` snippet calls `tools.settings.addNote` and the fixture gets the payload.
\ No newline at end of file
